Short note from infra:

We saw transient SES throttling in us-west-2 between 08:50–09:05 PST due to a spike in transactional sends from another flow. The throttling is per-sender-domain and per-region; the fallback domain (redwood-inference-ops.com) is on a different sending identity so it should avoid the same bucket.

Two gotchas we should watch for:
- Some corporate proxies rewrite or remove HTML <button> elements; when that happens the CTA can disappear in Outlook mobile. For immediate workaround, we can send a plain-text invite with an explicit link and a short subject line like "Fabrico — Supplier Portal Link" so it stands out.
- We can temporarily route Fabrico invites through our secondary SES identity (ops) and tag the messages so we can see delivery. We'll also add a 30s spacing on automated invites to stays under throttle thresholds.

I'll push the fallback send now and attach the send log.
